assignment.research.findings.title: Research coverage is extensive; this refresh is a representative review
assignment.research.findings.text: The separate Astra study records 371 image inspections across 11 requests: 151 draft-guide slides, 106 visible positioning slides, 58 unique interior references and 56 website images from 12 official pages. This refresh uses those indexed interpretations plus eight actually supplied image previews—not a second inspection of all 371 images. The two research documents are derived model analysis, not newly approved guidelines. All 151 visual-guide slides remain draft, including the locked-character caption and approval scorecard. Stored-only images receive no inspected labels here.

assignment.research.findings.title: Sleep heritage is expanding into a broader comfort proposition
assignment.research.findings.text: The official Our Story page traces Duroflex to Kerala in 1963 and describes expansion beyond mattresses into furniture and accessories. The supplied positioning defines the essence as Motivating Reset. The official article dated 28 November 2025 announces Designed to De-Stress and an evolution from sleep brand to science-backed comfort brand. These establish heritage and intended positioning; they do not independently validate stress treatment, physiological recovery or product efficacy.

assignment.research.findings.title: Public identity has changed; draft logo and typography remain unresolved
assignment.research.findings.text: The supplied official logo and homepage show a solid red symbol with uppercase DUROFLEX. W03 announces Designed to De-Stress; its indexed old/new comparison records the earlier Great Sleep. Great Health. identity. The inspected draft V018 instead displays lowercase serif duroflex and Better Sleep / A Brighter You, while V086 requests clean sans-serif hierarchy. Font substitution may contribute but is not established. Confirm production vectors, typography and tagline lockups rather than reconstructing them from slides; retain authentic branding already present on the selected product.

assignment.research.findings.title: Red signals recognition, but its environmental boundary is contradictory
assignment.research.findings.text: Draft V035 and V087 make red identification rather than an all-red room: logo, product tag, CTA or a restrained graphic anchor. The indexed review nevertheless records red shorts, bedding, cushions and throws in positive examples, whereas V128 prohibits red outfits, bedding and props while permitting a single object. This is an unresolved draft contradiction, not automatic permission. The homepage confirms red identity and interface accents, but supplies no authoritative colour values. Keep immutable product colour separate from optional styling and resolve environmental red before production.

assignment.research.findings.title: Extend the story from pause to participation, including retail
assignment.research.findings.text: Proposed narrative: arrival, settling, connection and readiness—not an entire campaign of closed eyes. Reading, conversation, hobbies or preparing to join others can express Motivating Reset without promising a product-caused transformation. In retail, translate the supplied strategy into arrival, attentive consultation, semi-private trials and unwind/social zones with unobstructed access. A decorative niche does not demonstrate a working store. Keep the experience neither clinical nor a luxury spa, and connect bedroom and lounge worlds through spatial logic rather than identical décor.

assignment.research.findings.title: Build a source-shot system with product integrity as the first gate
assignment.research.findings.text: Use the draft's World, Icon, Inhabited Hero and Intelligence classes as provisional planning prompts, then derive channel and sale layouts. Preserve the exact product's colour, construction, seams, labels and controls; check shared light, shadows, anatomy, contact and verified clearances before aesthetic review. Texture documents appearance, not composition or efficacy. Reconcile V065's four classes with V150's broader deliverables, and correct V151: eight ten-point criteria accompany a claimed total of 100. Neither its score nor any mandatory wording establishes approval.

assignment.research.findings.title: Proposed portfolio architecture is not the collected navigation
assignment.research.findings.text: Positioning P063 proposes folding Livein and Natural Living into a simplified architecture; P066–P074 develop Restore, Recharge, Oasis and Recalibrate and an expanded Neuma world. The later official navigation still retains multiple mattress ranges and overlapping routes. Proposed trackers, apps, masks and other future concepts are not proof of current availability. A Restore label reported on a product image does not establish adoption of the whole architecture. Obtain the adopted naming and migration map before changing public range names or assigning new product stories.

assignment.research.findings.title: Strategy claims and website claims do not constitute approved SKU proof
assignment.research.findings.text: P053 uses 200K strands, 4X airflow and pain/stress-release language; collected website copy uses one lakh-plus fibres and 3X breathability. These are not established like-for-like comparisons, so choosing the newer number would not resolve them. W11 and W12 also contain broad healing, circulation and recovery language. Treat these as attributed marketing statements, not independently validated effects. Medical, cortisol, pain-relief, stress-treatment, quantified-performance and guarantee claims require current, product-specific approved evidence. Customer counts and qualitative consumer observations likewise do not establish population statistics.

assignment.research.findings.title: Current selling intensity and dark technology treatments coexist with draft calm
assignment.research.findings.text: The inspected homepage screenshot combines black-and-gold Great Comfort Fest graphics, red gift plinths, a countdown and offer-led information with diverse category thumbnails. The indexed study also records dark Neuma staging and richer motion-sofa scenes. These document current executions, not permanent rules overriding the draft's warm domestic ambition. Keep commercial panels distinct from room photography and revalidate offers. W11 itself conflicts: product cards show 4–20% discounts while body copy promotes flat 50% launch deals; this cannot be carried into a fresh brief unresolved.

assignment.research.findings.title: Graphic gradients do not permit fabricated photographic backgrounds
assignment.research.findings.text: Draft V089–V090 propose rounded panels and subtle atmospheric gradients. The configured client scene-integration boundary prohibits fake white patches, contrast fades, haze, blur masks and gradients inside photographs. Draft examples and observed website treatments do not override that boundary. Use genuine architectural copy space or a clearly separate graphic canvas, with any graphic treatment subject to approval. Likewise, retouching language about distracting labels must not be read as permission to remove authentic product branding.

assignment.research.findings.title: Close production and research gaps before execution
assignment.research.findings.text: Select the exact official SKU, variant, channel and approved claim set before commissioning scenes. Confirm logo masters, typography, portfolio adoption and reference-reuse permissions; obtain dimensions or mechanism requirements wherever the composition needs them. Occupied massager and adjustable-bed sequences remain comparatively thin in the indexed study, and motion/video continuity was not reviewed. Social accounts are linked but their creative feeds are not established here. Meta access returned 403 and advertiser identity was not verified; no paid-creative, targeting, performance or audience conclusions follow.

assignment.guardian.requirements.text: Keep source authority tiers distinct: explicit user brief and named Duroflex scope govern the assignment; the May 2025 Strategic Blueprint supplies strategic intent (Motivating Reset) rather than product efficacy proof; the 151-slide Visual World Guide remains an unapproved draft throughout (even on slides marked mandatory, approved, or locked); interior archive images are advisory inspiration only; and exact official SKU pages govern product identity and available facts.

Preserve the exact selected official SKU's colour, fabric texture, seams, edge construction, controls, and authentic physical product labels/branding without recolouring, inventing mechanisms, or removing genuine product markings.

Do not use fake white patches, contrast fades, added haze, blur masks, or artificial gradients inside photographs to create copy space; rely on genuine architectural wall/floor space or clearly separate graphic panels.

Treat strategic positioning statements (such as 200K strands, 4X airflow, cortisol reduction, or stress/pain relief) and website marketing copy (such as 1 lakh+ fibres, 3X breathability, or healing/circulation language) as attributed statements rather than portable proof; require current, product-specific approved substantiation before making medical, physiological, quantified, or guarantee claims.

Express the strategic essence of 'Motivating Reset' and 'Designed to De-Stress' as warm, attentive, supportive, and insightful everyday restoration that helps people get back in the game—never promising a dramatic makeover, fear-mongering about stress/anxiety, making people feel bad about their lifestyle, or borrowing clinical or luxury-spa tropes.

assignment.guardian.preferences.text: Prefer the current public identity observed on the official website and November 2025 announcement—a solid red symbol with uppercase DUROFLEX and the 'Designed to De-Stress' philosophy—over the draft guide's unapproved lowercase serif wordmark and older 'Better Sleep / A Brighter You' tagline, pending vector master confirmation.

Use Duroflex red primarily as a brand signal and graphic punctuation (logo, product tag, CTA, thin accent line, or restrained graphic anchor) rather than flooding the room; avoid red curtains, red bedding, red props, and red outfits until the draft guide's internal contradictions are resolved.

Build calm through contemporary Indian domestic architecture and navigable circulation (clear entrance-to-window routes, low horizontal furniture, recessed storage, usable bedside/seating access, and framed exterior greenery) rather than hotel suites, resort arches, or beige minimalism.

Support the unchanged SKU colour with layered tonal separation and tactile variety—using draft palette proposals like bone, sand, taupe, stone, sage, olive, clay, wine, midnight blue, and soft sky alongside matte wood, stone, limewash/textured plaster, linen, and cotton—without forcing a single neutral palette across all categories.

Establish one credible primary light source (such as side glazing casting gentle shadows) supported by believable practical lamps, keeping SKU colours truthful; pair frontal silhouettes, three-quarter room views, and close contact/detail views rather than relying on wide-angle distortion.

Direct believable physical support and everyday participation—stretching, reading, reclining, conversing, or preparing to go out—dressed in relaxed, matte homewear (linen, washed cotton, fine jersey in muted tones), avoiding camera stares, thumbs-up, presenter poses, and forced ad smiles.

Flex environmental mood by category while keeping brand identity constant: airy daylight bedrooms for mattresses/beds (restrained blue-white freshness for Airboost; warm domestic trust without medical theatre for Duropedic); social warm lounges with verified extension clearance for sofas/motion; sheltered reading corners for recliners; intimate bedside contact for pillows; and warm domestic corners (not dark floating voids or clinics) for Neuma massagers.

Favour clean sans-serif information hierarchy, one clear focal message per layout, thin proof icons, and soft-edged/rounded graphic containment kept distinct from the room photograph, avoiding discount-poster clutter or starbursts.

assignment.facts.text: The collected official website markets mattresses, sofas, recliners, beds, pillows, accessories and smart sleep solutions in India.
Duroflex's official Our Story page traces its beginnings to Kerala in 1963; this is the brand's own historical account.
The official article dated 28 November 2025 announces Designed to De-Stress as Duroflex's new philosophy.
The supplied Strategic Blueprint defines Motivating Reset as the brand essence and an attentive, insightful, supportive and warm personality; these are strategic intentions.
The supplied Visual World Guide contains 151 slides and remains draft, including pages labelled approved, mandatory or locked and its approval scorecard.

Restore, Recharge, Oasis and Recalibrate appear in proposed strategy architecture, while collected navigation retains other range names. Adoption of the complete proposed architecture is not established.

Official supplied imagery uses a solid symbol and uppercase DUROFLEX; the draft renders a lowercase serif wordmark and older tagline despite requesting sans-serif typography. Final production masters are unresolved.
